scope: All acquired M4 documents selected into the fixed development Top-20; not human verified

decisions.reason: Directly explains recurrent sneezing/rhinorrhea that is strongest in the early morning or on waking and gives a clinically meaningful differential cause.
Explains vasomotor rhinitis triggers and morning symptoms, but does not fully explain awakening near dawn with repeated sneezing.
Pregnancy-specific allergic-rhinitis treatment is a population and intent mismatch.
Pregnancy allergic rhinitis does not address a nasopharyngeal cyst or nocturnal obstruction.
General recurrent rhinitis does not answer whether a nasopharyngeal cyst causes the obstruction.
Vasomotor rhinitis is not evidence about a nasopharyngeal cyst.
Navigation-heavy rhinitis content does not answer the cyst relation or treatment.
GERD-related rhinitis is a different condition and does not answer the cyst question.
General rhinitis surgery and folk-remedy content does not answer whether a nasopharyngeal cyst causes nocturnal obstruction.
Vitamin C appears in an unrelated dry-rhinitis treatment; hypothyroidism interaction is absent.
Explains H. pylori transmission, consequences and need for formal eradication treatment, but omits a symptom set and eradication regimen.
The body is navigation text and does not provide H. pylori symptoms or treatment.
Mentions H. pylori testing in dyspepsia but does not answer infection signs and definitive treatment.
Pediatric dyspepsia diet is not evidence about H. pylori infection.
Post-infection syndrome is unrelated to H. pylori signs and eradication.
Psychological care for functional dyspepsia is a different intent and condition.
Pregnancy allergic-rhinitis treatment does not address right chest pain at 38 weeks or signs of labor.
